reviews.text:
Thank you so much for grooming my two poodles the other day! 🎵
The cuts are always exactly to my liking, and they last a long time, which is a huge help! ❤️
Most importantly, I feel completely at ease leaving my dogs in your care. ✨
I've also been continuing with the "Shine & Gloss" treatment, and their coats are in excellent condition.
I'll definitely visit your Kachidoki store next time! 🌱

After grooming, my dog's paws were bright red and in pain from clipper burn.
I repeatedly explained this to the groomer, but it didn't improve, so I stopped going there.
I'm glad I've now found a good groomer.

I've been taking my dog, Tsubomi, to Salon de Lady Ny ever since she was born. They even pointed out areas of redness (on her skin) that I hadn't noticed after her haircut (it later turned out to be a food allergy), which I really appreciated. I look forward to continuing to use their services in the future. 🙇 …

We've been using their services since we had our first dog. They always respond to our requests very carefully and do a lovely job.

It's a very trustworthy shop.

We've been going to this salon since our dog's very first grooming session, and they always do a great job, leaving our dog looking adorable and carefully groomed. We always look forward to it. They're a trustworthy groomer who always addresses any concerns we have.

The toys and treats they sell are also tasteful and the salon is lovely.

They always do a very thorough job.

They also tell me the completion time almost always, so I can use the waiting time effectively.

They even take a cute photo at the end, which I look forward to every time.
I always love the cute cuts I get ✌️ After the cut and shampoo, they also take cute seasonal photos 💕 🎶 The 2026 New Year's card was an original 🥰 Thank you as always 😊 …
Highly recommended! Watanabe-san is really nice and her skills are top-notch! If you’re looking for a salon for your dog, look no further!

We used their services for our dog's first grooming session. Ms. Watanabe was very kind and gave us the impression that she genuinely cares about dogs. Although it was our dog's first grooming, she didn't seem too scared. After the grooming, her fur was neat and silky, which made us very happy. We would definitely like to use their services again!
